vectors.name: minimal-query
vectors.notes: Read-only outlet (Query semantics). cost = None. Smallest valid registration.

input.description: Smallest valid Query outlet — no cost, two-field schema.
input.name: Minimal Query

vectors.name: minimal-action
vectors.notes: Mutating outlet (Action semantics, the fail-safe default). cost = None.

input.description: Smallest valid Action outlet — no cost, two-field schema.
input.name: Minimal Action

vectors.name: query-cost-none
vectors.notes: Query outlet with explicit cost=None — exercises the absent-cost preimage branch (0x00 sentinel).

input.description: Query outlet, cost field omitted (None). Free read-only access.
input.name: Query Without Cost

vectors.name: query-cost-zero
vectors.notes: Query outlet with explicit OutletCost { amount: 0 } — cost present but zero. §5.4.2 Query structural floor.

input.description: Query outlet, cost present with amount=0. Demonstrates the cost-present-but-zero preimage path.
input.name: Query With Zero Cost

vectors.name: action-cost-positive
vectors.notes: Action outlet with cost.amount > 0. Exercises the cost-present-positive preimage path including currency + payee fields.

input.description: Paid Action outlet — cost amount=12345 USD, payee = operator DID.
input.name: Action With Positive Cost

vectors.name: with-aggregate-schema
vectors.notes: Registration whose schema declares a dedicated `aggregate_schema` describing the streamed-aggregate shape (§5.4.5). Exercises the three-field OutletSchema MessagePack encoding under `schema_hash`.

input.description: Outlet that streams chunks plus an aggregate value. The aggregate_schema describes the terminal End.aggregate shape.
input.name: Outlet With Aggregate Output Schema

vectors.name: max-size-schema
vectors.notes: Registration with input schema that approaches the 64 KiB serialized cap (§5.4.1). Stress-tests preimage byte concatenation across large variable-length fields.

input.description: Stress vector for large schemas approaching the 64 KiB serialized boundary.
input.name: Outlet With Maximum-Size Schema

vectors.name: with-100-test-vectors
vectors.notes: Registration carrying the §5.4.1 maximum-supported test vector count (100 entries). Exercises the test-vector iteration path in the canonical preimage construction.

input.description: Outlet carrying the maximum-supported number of registration test vectors.
input.name: Outlet With 100 Test Vectors

vectors.name: llm-backed-impl-hash
vectors.notes: Registration whose implementation_hash is computed per §5.4.1 LLM-backed rule (SHA-256(model_id || ":" || system_prompt_utf8)).

input.description: Outlet backed by a hosted LLM (model gpt-4-turbo, fixed system prompt).
input.name: LLM-Backed Outlet

vectors.name: remote-service-impl-hash
vectors.notes: Registration whose implementation_hash is computed per §5.4.1 remote-service rule (SHA-256(canonical_jcs(openapi_spec))). Includes a cost_formula for dynamic pricing (§19.4).

input.description: Outlet backed by an external HTTP API; impl hash covers the canonical OpenAPI spec.
input.name: Remote-Service Outlet

vectors.name: multi-caveat-invocation-target
vectors.notes: Registration intended for invocation under a UCAN with multiple caveats (§7.3.8 InvocationCaveats — amount_max_per_call, valid_until, allowed_adapters, etc.). The vector exercises a representative paid-Action shape against which a multi-caveat token would be minted.

input.description: Action outlet whose registered shape is compatible with multi-caveat UCAN invocation (amount_max_per_call + valid_until + allowed_adapters).
input.name: Multi-Caveat-Compatible Action

vectors.name: cross-context-invocation-target
vectors.notes: Registration intended for cross-context invocation through a §6.2.0.1 InterfaceOffer. Description signals the cross-context nature; preimage shape is the same as any Action outlet.

input.description: Action outlet exposed via cross-context interface (§6.2.0.1). Operator DID accountable across the bridged peer context.
input.name: Cross-Context Action
